summary.text: Kevin Craig is the Libertarian Party nominee for Missouri's 7th District, a seat he also sought in 2012, 2014, 2020, 2022 and 2024.
He holds a law degree, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a writer and editor.

paragraphs.text: Craig earned a high school diploma from Lowell High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Southern California in 1979 and a law degree from Trinity Law School in 1984.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as writer and editor.
Craig was the Libertarian candidate for Missouri's 7th District in 2012 (5.2%), 2014 (7.7%), 2020 (4.2%), 2022 (2.3%) and 2024 (2.2%), finishing third each time.
